newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open mixed Thursday, with the bullion market steady overnight.

But the US dollar rallied further and the price of gold in South African rand fell to new nine month lows and in Australian dollars to fresh five year lows overnight, prompting talk of more producer hedging, traders said.
COMEX April gold was seen opening unchanged to down 30 cents an ounce from Wednesday's close at $346.40, after trading in a $347.10-345.50 range in overnight ACCESS trade.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted early around $343.50/00, compared to the London Thursday morning fix at $343.40 and the New York close Wednesday at $343.90/40.
COMEX gold stocks fell 81,553 ounces Wednesday to 715,228 ounces.
COMEX March silver was seen opening unchanged to up 0.20 cent from Wednesday's close at $4.872, after trading in a $4.875-4.900 range in ACCESS.
COMEX silver stocks rose 142,258 ounces Wednesday to 195,472,438 ounces.

NYMEX April platinum was called to open unchanged to down 20 cents an ounce from the previous close at $356.40, while NYMEX March palladium was seen opening unchanged to up 50 cents from Wednesday's close at $129.75.
